title: Personal assistant memory
description: Six months of assistant chat history: budgets that change, schedules that move, projects that evolve. Shows dated recall, knowledge updates (the answer depends on WHEN), and temporal questions.
proves: Same memory, different as-of date → different truth
questions: How much is my rent, and when did it change?
Which days do I go to the gym, and at which location?
What did I end up doing for Lena's birthday and how much did it cost?
How has the Meridian project evolved since I joined it?
